definition.en: The end of a muscle that usually stays still when it contracts, often the end nearer the trunk.
definition.zh: 肌肉收缩时通常不动的那一端，一般是离躯干较近的一端。

definition.en: The end of a muscle that it pulls towards the origin when it contracts.
definition.zh: 肌肉收缩时被拉向起点的那一端。

definition.en: A flat, broad sheet of tendon that joins a muscle to bone or to another muscle.
definition.zh: 一层扁平宽阔的腱性薄膜，把肌肉连到骨头或另一块肌肉上。

definition.en: The bar of cartilage that joins the front end of a rib to the breastbone and lets the rib cage flex when you breathe.
definition.zh: 把肋骨前端连到胸骨上的一段软骨，让胸廓在呼吸时能够活动。

definition.en: A muscle whose fibres spread from a narrow end to a wide one, so that different fibres pull in different directions. Also called a convergent muscle.
definition.zh: 纤维从狭窄的一端散开到宽阔的一端的肌肉，不同的纤维朝不同方向拉。也叫会聚肌。

definition.en: A hook of the shoulder blade that points forward under the collarbone; pectoralis minor, coracobrachialis and the short head of biceps attach to it.
definition.zh: 肩胛骨上向前伸出、位于锁骨下方的钩状突起；胸小肌、喙肱肌和肱二头肌短头都附着在这里。

definition.en: Moving the shoulder blade forward around the rib cage, away from the spine, as in pushing or punching.
definition.zh: 肩胛骨沿着胸廓向前、远离脊柱移动，就像推东西或出拳时那样。

definition.en: The inner border of the shoulder blade lifting away from the ribs, often because serratus anterior is weak or its nerve is injured.
definition.zh: 肩胛骨内侧缘离开肋骨翘起，常常是因为前锯肌无力或支配它的神经受伤。

definition.en: Moving the raised arm forward and across the body in a horizontal plane, as in a hug or a fly.
definition.zh: 手臂抬起后在水平面上向前、向身体中线移动，就像拥抱或飞鸟。

definition.en: Recording the electrical activity of a muscle, usually with sensors stuck to the skin. It shows how active a muscle is, not how much it will grow.
definition.zh: 记录肌肉的电活动，通常用贴在皮肤上的电极。它显示肌肉有多活跃，但不能说明肌肉会长多少。

definition.en: The heaviest load a person can lift once with good form. Studies give loads as a percentage of it.
definition.zh: 一个人用标准动作只能举起一次的最大重量。研究常用它的百分比来表示负荷。

definition.en: The part of a movement in which a working muscle lengthens, such as lowering the bar in a bench press.
definition.zh: 动作中正在用力的肌肉被拉长的那一段，比如卧推时把杠铃放下。
